orders_growth.label: Order growth in the quarter, year on year

method: Backlog and orders as the filings' own words state them, read by fixed rules from MD&A, the 10-K's Item 1 and earnings releases (query_api/text_kpis.py): each value cites its passage and is kept only when its number is in that passage. A company may state them in ways these rules don't read; nothing is estimated or computed.
